headlines.text: Back on this day in 2023, Orange Cassidy vs. Wheeler Yuta fought tooth and nail for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.14 ? an excellent showing. Yuta showed a more aggressive side after Claudio Castagnoli fired him up at ringside, but Cassidy's Orange Punch and Beach Break combination proved too much in a match many called an instant classic.
Flash back to 2025, when Chris Jericho vs. Bandido closed out Collision, rated 7.19 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
On this day in 2021, Yuka Sakazaki vs. Emi Sakura crossed paths for the first time ever on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 7.81 ? a solid showing.
